tagline: REXR is a self-administered and self-managed REIT focused on owning, operating, and acquiring industrial properties in Southern California infill markets to generate attractive risk-adjusted returns.
hero_kpi_rationale: REXR's portfolio, measured in millions of square feet of leasable space, is the primary indicator of its size and reach in the Southern California industrial real estate market.

kpis.name: Portfolio Size (millions of square feet)
kpis.explanation: Total square footage of industrial properties owned by the company.
kpis.description: Represents the company's total leasing capacity in its target markets in Southern California.
kpis.signal: 51.2 million square feet portfolio in high-barrier markets.

kpis.name: Number of Properties
kpis.explanation: The total number of industrial real estate assets owned by the company.
kpis.description: Indicates the extent and diversification of the real estate portfolio of 419 properties.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.explanation: Total amount of debt incurred by the company, excluding unamortized bond issuance costs.
kpis.description: Represents the company's overall consolidated indebtedness.

kpis.name: Fixed-Rate Debt %
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total consolidated debt that is fixed-rate, either directly or through interest rate swaps.
kpis.description: Indicates that all debt is protected against rate fluctuations via contracts or swaps, eliminating interest rate volatility.
kpis.signal: 100% of consolidated debt is fixed-rate, reducing interest rate risk.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

ai_positioning.summary: Rexford Industrial Realty, Inc. focuses on industrial real estate and shows no indication of involvement or strategy related to artificial intelligence in the provided documents.
